title: Building Your Brand Online with Adam Rodricks
summary: Adam is Canada’s Top Social Media Strategist and bestselling author and has helped grow the digital presence of some of the country’s most prominent brands. With 15 years of experience and a reputation for turning “word of mouth” into “world of mouth,” Adam will share practical tools and strategies to help businesses strengthen their online presence and build trust with their audiences.
description: This workshop is presented by the Town of Stouffville and the Village of Stouffville Advisory Committee. Why Attend This Workshop As a business owner, you’ll learn how to: Build a strong online presence that attracts new customers and strengthens your brand. Leverage social media effectively with tools and strategies that save time and increase impact. Tell your business story online in a way that builds trust and connection. Use AI and digital tools to streamline your marketing and reach wider audiences. Turn followers into customers through practical, actionable tactics you can implement right away. Stay competitive by understanding digital trends that are shaping small business success today. About Adam Rodricks Adam is Canada’s Top Social Media Strategist and bestselling author and has helped grow the digital presence of some of the country’s most prominent brands. With 15 years of experience and a reputation for turning “word of mouth” into “world of mouth,” Adam will share practical tools and strategies to help businesses strengthen their online presence and build trust with their audiences. Parking Information There is a small parking lot located directly behind 19 on the Park with limited spaces available. Additional free street parking for up to three hours can be found nearby, as well as larger lots a short walk away at the 55+ Club and at the Booth Drive Parking Lot (Booth Dr, Whitchurch-Stouffville, ON L4A 8B6). Accessibility 19 on the Park is a fully accessible venue, featuring an accessible entrance, elevator access to all levels, designated seating areas, and accessible washrooms.
